description: Bill Foster is a scientist, businessman and U.S. Congressman. Bill is running for reelection in Illinois’ new 11th Congressional District. The district includes parts of two of Illinois’ largest cities, Aurora and Naperville. The new IL-11 includes parts of all five of Chicago’s collar counties, plus a small section of Cook County in Lemont.
